question: What harmful consequence follows if others are allowed to perform the prohibited act?
premises: Acting otherwise leads to destruction of the kingdom.
Others must therefore not be made to do it.
inference: To avoid destruction of the kingdom, one must not have others perform the act.
uncertainties: The specific act is implied from the preceding prohibition on touching the linga.
plain_english: Otherwise there would be destruction of the kingdom; therefore one should not have it done by others.
